name: Microwave Water Heating Robot Skills
description: Robot skills for the microwave water heating task — retrieving the heated black cup from the microwave via the UR5 External Control API

skills.name: Take Cup Out of Microwave
skills.description: Open the microwave door, reach in, grasp the heated black cup, and take it out onto the counter top

skills.name: Stop Program
skills.description: Emergency stop — halt the current program and hold at current position

skills.name: Wait
skills.description: Wait for a specified duration or until the human signals readiness
